source_review.notes: Checked seven official sources. OpenAPI 3.2.0 defines a language-neutral HTTP API description. JSON Schema identifies 2020-12 as its current published dialect. Current Pact documentation describes consumer-driven provider replay and pending expectations. Current Protocol Buffers guidance distinguishes wire-safe, compatible, and unsafe changes and requires reservation after field removal. GraphQL September 2025 and AsyncAPI 3.0.0 specifications define their current contract surfaces. Tool behaviors remain examples; matching, lifecycle, provenance, support, and deployment policy are explicit local responsibilities.

pedagogical_review.notes: The module begins with contract boundaries and forms, then develops graph evidence, matchers, provider states, verification, lifecycle, protocol variants, deployment gates, and portfolio limits. Counterexamples expose schema-equals-semantics, snapshots-equal-needs, latest/latest, and mock-success shortcuts. Ten examples and five progressive exercises have complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external standards-body, API provider, consumer team, testing-tool vendor, platform, security, or practitioner review is claimed.
